prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop landing-page UI mockup for BugReceipt, a privacy-first Chrome extension that records a tab, console errors, network activity, and manual QA steps, then lets the user review and export evidence locally. Use the two reference images only for BugReceipt's established visual identity and the real extension interface; do not copy the old page structure and do not use the name ReproKit. Canvas 1536x1024, polished product-design screenshot, credible browser-product marketing page. Direction: FIELD MANUAL SEQUENCE. Keep the established colors exactly in spirit: deep ink navy, pale paper/fog blue, thin desaturated blue rules, coral signal accent, teal trace accent. Square geometry, thin technical rules, Bricolage-Grotesque-like display type and compact monospaced labels. The first viewport must feel like a numbered operating manual, not a generic SaaS template: minimal navigation, left-aligned benefit headline "Record the failure. Keep the evidence.", one primary CTA "Download BugReceipt", and a large dominant annotated plate of the actual extension UI. Add four precise evidence callouts pinned to the extension plate: Screen, Console, Network, Steps. Introduce one intentional density collision: a coral status band crossing the lower edge of the hero plate with the message "Nothing sent without your click". Hint at the next section below as bold numbered manual rows explaining Record, Review, Export. Strong hierarchy, asymmetric editorial composition, generous but purposeful negative space. No gradients, no rounded card grid, no glassmorphism, no pill-heavy UI, no decorative blobs, no fake testimonials, no excessive marketing copy. All text must be crisp and correctly spelled.
